cited.quote: From the year 2018-19 the beneficiaries who are undertaking this Pilgrimage has been enhanced from 500 to 600
G.O. (MS) No.50, BC, MBC & MW Dept (MWRU), Dt. 31.8.18
have performed this pilgrimage by availing financial assistance of Rs.660 lakh

rationale: The Jerusalem pilgrimage assistance scheme continued through the term: C3 shows annual beneficiaries and releases for 2016-17 and 2017-18, and a GO (MS) No.50 dated 31.8.18 enhancing beneficiaries from 500 to 600. C1 confirms continued assistance. The earliest dated official step in the term is that GO; the scheme itself predates the government.
